_doc: Candidate v4mq: lgb_v4m frame model (v4 configuration with the three public Metrica sample games added to training) + temporal stacker on the frame model's probabilities only (no onset channel, no ball cues, no nearest-player margin) (mtah.model_stacked over models/lgb_v4m; stacker fitted on v4m's leave-one-match-out out-of-fold probabilities of the DFL matches only, docs/stacker.md) + frozen decoder, kickoff rule on.
